item.title: Concerns rise over DHS shutdown in shadow of Iran strikes: 'Now would be a good time' to end it
item.description: Lawmakers and DHS sound the alarm over unpaid agency employees as homeland security comes into focus after Trump and Netanyahu's Iran strikes.

item.title: US Olympic hockey hero Jack Hughes opens up about support for women's team amid backlash over Trump's joke
item.description: Jack Hughes defended the U.S. men's hockey team's support for women's players after backlash over their response to President Donald Trump's joke during a gold medal call.

item.title: MIKE DAVIS: Why Trump's Iran strike was necessary and lawful
item.description: Mike Davis discusses presidential war powers and constitutional authority for military action without congressional approval in various international contexts.

item.title: Iran vows 'decisive' self-defense at UN after Trump kills supreme leader in Operation Epic Fury
item.description: Iran's U.N. ambassador condemned U.S. strikes that killed Supreme Leader Khamenei, calling the attack a sovereignty violation at a Security Council meeting.

item.title: Iranians celebrate worldwide after supreme leader is killed in Israeli strikes
item.description: Coordinated strikes killed Iran's Khamenei, and citizens celebrated across the world, waving flags and chanting about freedom after decades of oppression.

item.title: Mamdani's response to Trump's Iran strike sparks conservative backlash: 'Rooting for the ayatollah'
item.description: NYC socialist Mayor Zohran Mamdani faces conservative backlash after condemning Trump's Iran strike that killed Ayatollah Khamenei, calling it an illegal war.

item.title: Iran goes dark amid 'regime paranoia', blackout follows Israeli, US strikes on compound
item.description: Iran's internet connectivity flatlined at 1% after strikes on a Tehran regime compound, marking one of the world's rare wartime national blackouts according to global internet monitors.

item.title: Voice of America pushes Trump’s message inside Iran as regime clamps down on communications: reports
item.description: VOA Persian service reportedly continues broadcasting inside Iran despite regime communication restrictions, covering "Operation Epic Fury" and Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei's death.

item.title: US women's basketball player in Israel shares panic in footage of Iranian counterattack on Jerusalem
item.description: Former NCAA champion Destiny Littleton documented her harrowing escape to bomb shelters as Iranian missiles and drones struck Jerusalem, where she plays professional basketball.

item.title: Khamenei’s death opens uncertain chapter for Iran’s entrenched theocracy
item.description: Iran enters a pivotal transition following Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s death, as clerical elites and the powerful IRGC maneuver to preserve the Islamic Republic.
